detail: All declared MVP inputs and eight canonical tables exist.
Eight tables rebuilt in a temporary directory match canonical outputs byte-for-byte.
All four investor figures regenerated from rebuilt tables and passed minimum file-size checks.
Screening outputs contain 25 facilities x 3 cases and four companies x 3 cases.
Facility/case and company/case keys are unique.
Six CAPEX and operational-emissions measures reconcile exactly from facilities to companies.
Company CAPEX and operational abatement are monotonic across low/base/high cases.
Support outputs contain 25 facilities x 3 assumptions x 4 mechanisms and four companies at the same cases.
Facility and company support keys are unique.
Six capital, support and abatement measures reconcile exactly from facilities to companies.
Every positive additional operational-abatement row names a facility status change.
Support totals rise and residual common exposure falls monotonically across low/base/high mechanism assumptions.
Cost-gap outputs contain 87 facility-variant-case rows and 15 company-variant-case rows.
Facility and company cost-gap keys are unique.
Six CAPEX, abatement, annual resource-gap and support-stress measures reconcile exactly from facilities to companies.
Screening, support, cost and production tables all contain the fixed four-company sample.
Nippon publishes 100% production coverage within the 2% tolerance; the other three companies remain NA and none is zero-filled.
Gwangyang capacity coverage, full-route multiple and implied scrap demand reproduce from the disclosed capacity and allocated activity.
System abatement remains not modelled and legacy pathway/support tables do not silently backfill production coverage.
All mechanism assumptions retain estimate label, range, unit, price-year treatment, formula, rationale and quality D.
All external source IDs in processed inputs resolve to the source register.
POSCO, Nippon and LOTTE primary cost/support emissions boundaries align within 0.1%.
Mitsui primary cost coverage is 97.46% versus 85.00% in the legacy support experiment, a 12.46 percentage-point difference; exact combined support/cost claims are gated.
Production coverage is publishable for 1/4 companies; POSCO, LOTTE and Mitsui remain NA rather than zero.
Nippon's new 100% production coverage is not yet propagated into the capital-allocation and support tables, which retain the older NA field.
The completed Gwangyang EAF covers only 13.15% of allocated base works activity; full-route project-backed CAPEX and abatement are gated.
Verified incentive-adjusted cost gaps remain NA for all company cost rows; support amounts are sensitivities, not realised cash.
System abatement remains unavailable because leakage and replacement production are not modelled.
13 top-level status entries are untracked; reproducible files exist but are not yet protected by version history.
